lines.text: Here is a day with Agent R Q without touching the mouse once. Imagine the cable is unplugged.
The day starts with the letter N. It opens a new task, so you can file an idea before you forget it.
Type the title, add a line of detail, and send it. The agent has its work before your coffee cools.
W jumps to a workspace. It opens a quick search, so you type a few letters and press enter.
M jumps to a machine the same way. Type a few letters of its name, and you are looking at its terminal.
Command K finds any task by title or description, instantly, and it runs straight from your device.
You only remember one word, migration. Type it, and the matching tasks appear while you are still typing.
Arrow to the one you want and press enter. No scrolling through two hundred old tasks.
When an agent asks for permission, the keys handle that too, so a quick decision never needs the mouse.
And if you forget a shortcut, question mark lists every one of them in a single panel.
Your hands never leave the keyboard, so you stay faster than any menu, and your focus stays on the work.
Learn the five keys today, and try it all at Agent R Q dot com.
